name: Nishinomiya Shrine
type: Shinto shrine; Ebisu shrine; massha; Shikinai Ronsha; Shikinai Subshrine
text: Nishinomiya Shrine (西宮神社, Nishinomiya jinja) is a Shinto shrine in Nishinomiya, Hyōgo, Japan. It is the head shrine of the Ebisu sect of Shinto, and it is said that there are about 3,500 shrines under it. Locals call the shrine "Ebessan".

depictions.name: Nishinomiya Shrine
depictions.text: Nishinomiya Shrine (西宮神社) is a Shinto shrine in Nishinomiya in Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan. At the time of the Sengoku period, the shrine was part of the province of Izumi Settsu.
